# 00000004827

**English.** Definition: The Maass subspace is the subspace generated by Maass lifts. Conjecture: The quotient dimension of the full space of weight five halves over this subspace is an explicit count of compact-group representations, finite and uniform in the prime index. (compact-group count formula of Maass quotients)

**中文。** 定义：Maass 子空间指由 Maass 提升生成的子空间。猜想：权二分之五的全空间对该子空间的商维数为紧群表示的显式计数,计数有限且公式对一切素数指数一致。（Maass 商紧群计数公式）
